definitions.explanation: digging out minerals, ores, or natural resources from the earth for commercial use

examples.japanese: {石炭|せきたん}を{採掘|さいくつ}する。
この{地域|ちいき}では{金|きん}の{採掘|さいくつ}が{行|おこな}われていた。
examples.english: Gold mining was conducted in this area.

examples.japanese: {採掘|さいくつ}{権|けん}をめぐって{争|あらそ}いが{起|お}きた。
examples.english: A dispute arose over mining rights.

examples.japanese: {環境|かんきょう}への{影響|えいきょう}から{採掘|さいくつ}が{制限|せいげん}されている。
examples.english: Mining is restricted due to environmental impact.

notes:
{採掘|さいくつ} refers specifically to mining or extracting natural resources from the earth for commercial purposes.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {採|さい} (gather, collect, take)
- {掘|くつ} (dig)

USAGE:
- {採掘|さいくつ}する (to mine - suru verb)
- {採掘|さいくつ}{権|けん} (mining rights)
- {採掘|さいくつ}{場|じょう} (mining site)

COMMON OBJECTS:
- {石炭|せきたん}の{採掘|さいくつ} (coal mining)
- {金|きん}の{採掘|さいくつ} (gold mining)
- {石油|せきゆ}の{採掘|さいくつ} (oil extraction)
- {鉱石|こうせき}の{採掘|さいくつ} (ore mining)
- {天然|てんねん}ガスの{採掘|さいくつ} (natural gas extraction)

CONTRAST:
- {発掘|はっくつ}: archaeological excavation or talent discovery
- {採掘|さいくつ}: commercial extraction of natural resources
- {掘削|くっさく}: drilling (often for oil/gas wells)

RELATED TERMS:
- {発掘|はっくつ} (excavation - archaeological)
- {掘削|くっさく} (drilling, excavation)
- {鉱山|こうざん} (mine)
- {鉱業|こうぎょう} (mining industry)
